text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Imi yefra umennuɣ n Franṣa, Lalman tebda tettheggay iman-is i wakken ad tenbez tigzirin n Briṭanya.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Maca, drus maḍi n yiɣeṛṛuba n Tegriwa Tageldant i yellan zdat n yiberdan n unbaz imi iqebṭanen ugaden ad ten-sɣerqen tinṭagin Tilalmaniyin n tegnawt.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Iyyaw anebdu s usegzi ɣef yiɣuwas n Ṭelyan. Ṭelyan tella s wudem agejdan d "gma-s amecṭuḥ" n Lalman d Jabu.

text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Iswiyen igejdanen n Ṭelyan d timura n Tefriqt. I wakken ad ṭṭfen timura-agi, ilaq ad sεun tajumma n uceggeε n tekra, i wakken ad ssilelent tikra deg Yilel Amagrakal yerna ad nebzen Tafriqt.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Akud d ayen iɣ-d-izzin akk, yarna isɛa tazrirt ɣef ayen akk nxeddem, maca iwɛeṛ i ufham.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nettwali akud am umazrar n tedyanin id-ileḥḥun seg imal ɣer tura ara iɛeddin umbeɛd ɣer yezri.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Akud daɣen d amek nsemgarad laɛḍil (teɣzi) n tedyanin.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Tzemreḍ ad tqisseḍ akud ittɛeddin i yiman-ik s taɛsast n tedyant i yezgan tettuɣal-d. Tadyant id-yettuɣalen d ayen i yezgan iḍeṛṛu-d.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: I waṭas n lweqt di Lqaṛn wis mraw d tẓa akked wis snat n tmarwin, ɣidden yemdanen belli imezdaɣ imezwura n Ziland Tamaynut d agdud n Mawri, i yellan ttṣeyyiden ifrax imeqqranen iwumi qqaren mawas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Tamuɣli-agi umbeɛd tefka-d tikti id-iqqaren belli agdud n Mawri iguǧǧ si Bulinizya di tṛemmuɛt tameqqrant n teflugin dɣa kksen-asen Zilanda Tamaynut i Imuryuriten, anda id-sekren timetti tamɣigrant.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Akken ibɣu yili, anzaten imaynuten skanen-d belli Imuryuriten llan d agraw deg ugdud n Mawri i yeguǧǧen si Zilanda Tamaynut ɣer Tegzirin n Čatam, anda snernan idles-nsen yemgaraden di lehna.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Tella daɣen teqbilt niḍen di tegzirin n Čatam d imdanen n Mawri i yeguǧǧen si Zilanda Tamaynut.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Imdanen ittekkin aṭas n iseggasen ḥuman-aɣ ad nefk azal i tezmert-neɣ akked wacu neḥemmel yarna xedmen aktazal i wuguren akked ula d lexṣaṛat s tidett.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: S usmeḥses i tmicuha n yemdanen, n twacult-nsen, akked tuddsa-nsen, nḥella-d tamusni isɛan azal ɣef yezri akked kra n ṭbiɛat i yesɛan tazrirt ilhan neɣ n diri ɣef idles n tuddsa.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Xas akken afham n umezruy n yiwen mačči d afham n yidles, ittḥami imdanen anda ma ulac ad d-afen iman-nsen daxel n umezruy n tuddsa.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Deg uktazal n tarnawin akked ufiqi i lexṣaṛat, imdanen akked wid akk ittekkin ttafen-d s telqey imenzayen, tuɣdaṭ akked lebɣi txeddem tuddsa.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Deg umedya-agi, asmekti s imedyaten iɛeddan n lexdayem id-iglan s ternawin iḥuma imdanen ad ldin tiwwura i ubeddel akked ibardan imaynuten i tmezdayt tadigant.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Timicuha n tarnawt am ta-gi senqasent tigdi n ubeddel, slalayent-d lmil ilhan ɣer ubeddel deg imal.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Udmawen n twengimt imiqṛaben d titwilin n ferru n wuguren i yesdukkulen tiktiwin neɣ annaren yemgaraden i tifin n tifrat.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Ṣṣenf-agi n ttexmam ittkel ɣef tazla, tameẓla akked tiseddi, daɣen aɛqal n tedyanin, aɛiwed n usexdem n tetwilin yellan yakan, ajmaɛ n yisallen.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Ayen isɛan azal yakk di ttexmam-agi: tella kan yiwet n tririt iṣeḥḥan. Ad txemmemeḍ kan ɣef snat n tririyin, tin iṣeḥḥan neɣ tin icḍen.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Ṣṣenf-agi n twengimt iqqen ɣer kra n tussna neɣ tsekkirin tinawayin.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Imdanen isɛan ṣṣenf-agi n twengimt sɛan tawengimt iṛeznen, zemren ad cfun i wunuɣen, ad frun iɣeblan yarna ad xedmen ɣef tirmitin n tussna.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Imdanen d ṣenf n terwiḥin i yufraren akk di leqṛaya n tiktiwin n wiyiḍ.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Amedya, lukan ad twaliḍ yiwen ittruẓ ṭaq n tkeṛṛust, ahat ad tɣiddeḍ ibɣa ad tt-yaker.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Ad tḥekmeḍ fell-as akken niḍen lukan d ttittin i yettu tisura n tkeṛṛust-is yarna d takeṛṛust-is i wuɣuṛ ittɛaṛaḍ ad ikcem.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Radyu n Urgagi n Dkir tebna ɣef yiwet n tumant n tfizikt qqaren-as argagi n dkir ulawan, i d-yufa Feliks Bluk deg iseggasen n 1930 (mi yexeddem di Tesdawit n Stanfurd) akked Edward Bursel (n Tesdawit n Harbard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Deg urgagi-agi, annar n dkir akked lemwaji n ṛadyu deggiren ibelkimen ad d-ḍeggṛen licarat n ṛadyu timecṭaḥ.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Deg useggas n 1970, Raymund Damadyan, d amejjay yarna d amusnaw n unadi, yufa-d lsas i usexdem n ṛadyu n urgagi n dkir d allal deg usennefru asejjan.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ukkuz n iseggasen umbeɛd iffeɣ-d uselkin n isnulfu, i yellan d amezwaru di ddunit deg unnar n ṛadyu n urgagi n dkir.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Tigzirin n Kuk ur sɛint ara timdinin maca sɛant 15 n tegzirin yemgaraden. Tigejdanin d Rarutunga akked Aytutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Di tmura innernan ass-agi, sɛaya n wussu akked tiremt n sbaḥ n ulaɣem yuɣal sulin-as aswir am akken d ṣenf n tẓuṛi.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ɣer taggara, isensa n B&B ttemyezwaren s umata ɣef sin lecɣal igejdanen : ussu akked tiremt n sbaḥ.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: S wakka, deg usensu amaway gar-asen tzemreḍ ad tafeḍ ussu n ulameɣ, ahat taduli ixedmen s ufus neɣ ussu n zik.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Tiremt n sbaḥ izmer ad tesɛu lmakla n tallit n temnaḍt-nni neɣ lmakla timeẓlit n usensu-nni.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Amekkan izmer ad yili d azadaɣ amazray aqdim s iruka n zik, akked innaren ittucebbḥen akked tnerdabt.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mi ara taliḍ ɣer tkeṛṛust-ik ad teṭṭfeḍ abrid ɣezzifen i tteḥwas isɛa azal ijebbden mliḥ di tashuli-nes.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Baṛṛa n tkeṛṛusin timeqqranin, ahat twulfeḍ yakan tnehhart n takeṛṛust-ik yarna tesneḍ tilisa-nes.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Asbeddi n tqiḍunt deg wayla uslig neɣ di temdint tameqqrant neɣ tamecṭuḥt tezmer ad tejbed s tashuli tamuɣli ur nettwaɣa ara.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ihi, asexdem n tkeṛṛust-ik ilha i uḥewwes maca idrus usexdem-is i "usdar".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Asdar s tkeṛṛust izmer ad yili ma tesɛiḍ tafurgutt, takeṛṛust umi qqaren kat kat, takeṛṛust tameqqrant neɣ Staycen Wagun isɛan ikersiwen ittaḍlaqen.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Kra n isensa sɛan tigemmi n wakud n ddheb n ibardan n tmacinin n iraggen akked lbaburat ; uqbel Ṭṛad Amaḍlan wis Sin, di lqaṛn wis 19 neɣ tazwara n wis 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Deg isensa-agi i llan ttilin imaṛkantiyen akked wid imucaɛen di lweqt-nni, yarna ttaken-d sumata lmakla n lɛali akked zzhu n yiḍ.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Sɛaya n leḥwal n zik, lexṣaṣ n ttawilat imaynuten, akked yiwet akken n tewser d aḥric di lewṣayef-nsen.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Xas akken s umata d ayla uslig, tikwal steṛḥiben s iqeṛṛa n tmura akked imdanen niḍen isɛan azal.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Aḥewwas isɛan taṛemmuɛt n yedrimen izmer ad ibɣu ad ixdem affug ara d-izzin i ddunit, ara ibḍun s tɣimiyin deg aṭas n isensa-agi.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Aẓeṭṭa n usterḥeb d tuddsa isemlalayen iḥewwasen akked imezdaɣ idiganen n temdinin wuɣuṛ ara rzun.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Attekki deg uẓeṭṭa am wagi s umata itteḥwiǧi kan aɛemmer n twerqett di anternet; xas akken kra n uẓeḍwan tteḥwiǧin zyada n ttfaṣil.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Umuɣ n imesterḥben iwejden ad ittunefk di tewriqt akked/neɣ di anternet, tikwal s isallen akked iktazalen n wiyiḍ.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Kawčsurfin tettusnulfa-d di Yennayer 2004 mbeɛd mi d-yufa umsihel Kazey Fentun affug iṛexsen ɣer Island maca ur d-yufi ara anda ara yens.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Iceyyeɛ tibratin tiliktrunikin i yinelmaden n tesdawit tadigant erran-as-d aṭas n tririyin n usensu n baṭel.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Isensa n ilmeẓyen mexdumen s wudem agejdan i yelmeẓyen - inebgi s umata ittili deg iseggasen-is n snat n tmarwin - maca tzemreḍ ad tafeḍ ula d iḥewwasen imɣaren.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Idrus anda ara twaliḍ tiwaculin s igerdan, maca kra n isensa n ilmeẓyen sterḥiben yisen di texxamin tusligin.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Tamdint n Bikin di Ṣṣin d tamdint timestaṛḥebt s Wuraren Ulambiyen n Ccetwa di 2022, s wakka ad tuɣal d tamdint tamezwarut i yesterḥben s wuraren Ulambiyen n unebdu akked ccetwa di sin.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Bikin ad texdem tifugla n tazwara akked taggara akked tedyanin n ugris n daxel n wexxam.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Tidyanin niḍen n uḥlucceg ɣef udfel ad ilint di temnaḍt n uḥlucceg ɣef udfel n Tayzičeng di Zhangjyaku, azal n 220km (140 n lemyal) si Bikin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Amur ameqqran n ifakanen sɛan tafaska n useggas ibeddun si taggara n Wunbir arma d talemmast n Magu, i yettemxalafen aɛlaḥsab n taswast n yal afakan.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Amur ameqqran n tfaskiwin n ufakan ttusfugulent am uḥric n umulli n ufakan neɣ umulli n tṛebbanit taselwayt neɣ am akk tidyanin niḍen tigejdanin yaɛnan afakan.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Tifaskiwin n ufakan n Kirala ilha mliḥ i umuqqel, s lfilat ittucebbḥen, urkistra n ufakan akked tmeɣriwin niḍen.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Timzikent n Ddunit (iwumi qqaren Timzikent n Ddunit, neɣ Timzikent kan) d tafaska tagreɣlant tameqqrant n tẓuṛi akked tussniwin.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Timura ittekkin xeddment timzikenin n tẓuṛi akked leqraya di tamiwin tiɣelnawin i uskan n wuguren n ddunit neɣ n yidles akked umezruy-nsent.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Timzikenin Tigreɣlanin n Yemɣan d tidyanin timeẓliyin ixeddmen timzikenin n tjeǧǧigin, n tmizar akked akk ayen yaɛnan imɣan.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Xas akken lukan d lebɣi ttilint yal seggas (imi ttilint di tmura yemxalafen), deg unnar ur ttilint ara yal aseggas.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Tidyanin-agi ttekkent ger krad ar seddis n wagguren, ttaṭṭafent amekkan ur nelli ara ddaw n 50 ihiktaren.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Llan waṭas n imusal yemgaraden n isura i yettwasxedmen aṭas n iseggasen ay-agi. Asaru n 35mm Alugan (ibbaw n 36 ɣef 24 mm) d win i yemucaɛen yakk.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Izmer ad ittubeddel s tashuli ma ikfa, yarna ittak-d temɣer n tugniwin ittemcabin ɣer tin n DSLR n tura.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Kra n tweṣṣafin n isura n imusal ilemmusa sexdament amasal n 6 ɣef 6 cm, s wudem usdid ibbaw n 56 ɣef 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Tettak-d temɣeṛ n tugna qrib ukkuz n tikkal n tin n yibbaw n 35 mm (3136 mm2 mgal 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Tudert taweḥcit d ayen iwaɛṛen i win i ttaṭṭafen tugniwin, iḥwaǧ zzher, ssbeṛ, tamusni akked leḥwal n lɛali.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Aṣewweṛ n tudert taweḥcit aṭas is-iqqaren ishel, maca am uṣewweṛ s umata, tugna teswa alef n lehduṛ.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Aṣewweṛ n tudert taweḥcit s umata itteḥwiǧi tarejlajt timseqṛebt, xas akken lecɣal am tṛemmuɛt n yefrax neɣ imexluqen imecṭaḥ tteḥwiǧin ṣenf niḍen n trejlajin.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Aṭas n iɣerṣiwen ibaṛṛaniyen waɛṛen i tifin, yarna ilmaten tikwal seɛɛun isuḍaf yaɛnan tuṭṭfa n tugniwin i yeswi asenzan.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Iɣerṣiwen iweḥciyen zemren ad ilin ttsetḥin neɣ ttawḍen. Tawennaḍt tezmer ad tili tsemmeḍ, teḥma, neɣ tewɛeṛ.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Ddunit tesɛa aɣleb n 5000 n tutlayin yemgaraden, gar-asent kter n snat n tmarwin hedren-tent 50 imelyan neɣ kter.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Awalen yuran s umata sehlen akter i ufham ɣef wawalen ittwanṭqen. Aya-gi yaɛna abaɛda tansiwin, ittiwɛiṛen s umata i lmenṭeq.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Aṭas n tmura hedrent Taglizit akken igerrez, yarna deg uṭun imeqqṛen akter n tmura tzemreḍ ad tafeḍ ciṭ n tmussni deg-s - abaɛda ɣer yelmeẓyen.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Xayel-d, ma tebɣiḍ, Amankuni, Abustuni, Ajamayki akked umezdaɣ n Sidni qqimen ɣer ṭabla setten imensi di ṛasṭuṛa di Ṭuruntu.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ḥekkun-d timicuha n tmura-nsen, s lmenṭeq-nsen yemgaraden akked lehduṛ-nsen idiganen.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Tiɣin n lmakla deg wagens asenzan s umata d tarrayt iṛxisen yakk i lmakla. Mebla tignatin n usebbi, lxetyaṛ i yellan d lmakla iheggan kan.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Simmal ttilin deg igensan isenzanen imukan isɛan lxetyaṛat akteṛ n lmakla iheggan. Kra sɛan ula d afuṛnu ileḥḥun s lemwaji timecṭaḥ neɣ allalen niḍen i useḥmu n lmakla.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Di kra n tmura neɣ kra n leṣnaf n tḥuna tettili anda ma ulac yiwet n ṛasṭuṛa, s umata war-tunṣibt s sumat yarxisen.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Xdem-d yarna awi talsuffɣin n tsertit-ik akked isallen yaɛnan ṭamen-ik akkid-k.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ilaq ad seknen imayl n ṭamen akked wuṭunen n tilifun igreɣlanen i naṣayeḥ/ttesriḥat akked ucetki.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Eǧǧ talsuffeɣt niḍen di leḥwal-ik akked deg anternet (ceyyeɛ imayl i yiman-ik s ufaylu-agi, neɣ ejmeɛ-it di "taguyt").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ma tettinigeḍ s uselkim neɣ tetablitt, ejmeɛ-it di ccfawat-is neɣ deg uḍebsi (iwejden mebla anternet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Yernu efk talsuffɣin n tsertit/isallen i imdukkal n tteḥwas akked wid ik-ittilin neɣ imdukkal-ik di tmurt-ik i yebɣan ad ɛiwnen.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Muz (ittwassnen daɣen s yisem n elk) ur ttawḍen ara, maca ttḥuddun iman-nsen ma hulfan i umihi.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ma yili lɣaci ur ḥsiben ara muz d amihaw, zemren ad aẓen ɣur-s mliḥ s wakka ad d-afen iman-nsen deg umihi.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Sew iɣisem s ṛzana. Iɣisem isɛa tazrirt s wudem yemgaraden ɣef yal yiwen, s wakka tamusni n tlisa-nek isɛa mliḥ azal.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Uguren n tdawsa s teɣzi n wakud n waṭas n tissit izmer ad tili gar-asen lemḍaṛṛa n tassa akked ula d tideṛɣelt d lmut. Amihi ittimɣuṛ s tissit n iɣisem ittwaxedmen s wudem aruzrif.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Iɣisem aruzrif izmer ad isɛu ifardisen imihawen yemgaraden gar-asen mitanul, i yezemren ad d-yeglu s tdeṛɣelt neɣ lmut xas s tkemmicin timecṭaḥ.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Nwaḍeṛ zemrent ad ilint ṛxisent di tmurt tabaṛṛanit, abaɛda di tmura isɛan tijeṛniḍin timecṭaḥ anda lexlaṣ n ixeddamen yeṛxes.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Xemmem ad txedmeḍ akayad n wallen di tmurt-ik, abaɛda ma tɣumm-it ṭmana, umbeɛd awi lkaɣeḍ-nni n nwaḍeṛ ik-ilaqen ad k-tent-id-xedmen anda niḍen.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Nwaḍeṛ n lmarkat n lɛali illan di temnaḍin-agi zemrent ad sɛunt sin wuguren ; kra izmer mačči d tineṣliyin, ma d tid n tidett id-ittwaceyyɛen si lbaṛṛani ɣlayent ahat kter n tmurt-ik.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Lqahwa d yiwet si tɣawsiwin ittnuzen s waṭas di ddunit, yarna tzemreḍ ad d-tafeḍ ahat aṭas n leṣnaf di temnaḍt anda tzedɣeḍ.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Maca, llant waṭas n tarrayin yemgaraden n tissit n lqahwa di ddunit maṛṛa i yuklalen aɛṛaḍ.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Akanyuni d aṣubbu ɣer lqaɛ n wassif, ama iqquṛ ama iččur d aman.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Akanyuni isdukkul iferdisen id-yekkan si lɛum, talleyt n idurar akked ungaz--maca itteḥwiǧi ciṭ n usluɣmu neɣ cṭaṛa iwakken ad tebduḍ (mačči am talleyt n iẓṛa, aɣḍas neɣ aḥlucceg deg idurar n alb).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Tikli d ccɣel ittilin baṛṛa n wexxam d tikli di twennaḍt tagamant, s umata deg ibardan ittwaxedmen i tikli.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Tikli n wass taɛna teɣzi n ibardan ur newwiḍ ara yiwen n lmil arma d tin ɣezzifen kter i yezmer umdan ad ilḥu deg yiwen n wass.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Tikli n wass deg ubrid isehlen teḥwaǧ kan ciṭ n uheggi, yarna yal win isɛan tazmert talemmast kan ad yaff iman-is deg-s.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Tiwaculin isɛan igerdan imecṭaḥ zemrent ad ḥwiǧent aheggi akter, maca tuffɣa deg uzal teshel ula s igerdan ileqqaqen akked igerdan urɛad nekcim ɣer uɣerbaz.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: S wudem agreɣlan, llant wazal n 200 n tuddsiwin n tteḥwas. Amur ameqqran deg-sent xeddment s wudem amunan.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Tin yuɣalen deg umekkan n Glubal Rannin Tawerz, Gaw Rannin Tawerz teqqen aṭas n wid id-ittakken imeẓla n uḥewwes di ukkuz n imenẓawen.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: S iẓewṛan id-yekkan si Rannin Tawerz Barsuluna di Barsuluna akked Rannin Kubinhagen di Kubinhagen, ur iɛeṭṭel ara irna-d ɣuṛ-sen Rannin Tawerz Brag di Brag akked wiyiḍ.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Llan waṭas n lecɣal fayef i yelaq ad txemmemeḍ uqbel akked mi ara tinigeḍ ɣer walebɛaḍ n imukan.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Mi ara tinigeḍ, gmen ɣef lecɣal ad ilin mxalafen ɣef "tmurt-ik". Lexdayem, isuḍaf, lmakla, tikli n tkeṛṛusin, asensu, imenzayen, tutlayt akked wayen niḍen ad imxalaf ɣef anda tettidireḍ.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: D taɣawsa i yelaqen ad teqqim i lbal-ik, iwakken ur tettneɣniḍ ara neɣ ur tkarreheḍ ara amek xeddmen lecɣal imezdaɣ idiganen.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Tikebbaniyin n uḥewwes llant si lqaṛn wis 19. Axeddam n tteḥwas s umata d lxetyaṛ igerzen i yinig ara iɛeddin akkin i tirmit taqdimt n uḥewwas deg ugama, idles, tutlayt neɣ di tmura isɛan lmedxul amecṭuḥ.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Xas akken amur ameqqran n tkebbaniyin n uḥewwes ttaqbalent amur ameqqran n uheggi n imukan, aṭas d timaẓlayin deg yiwen n ṣenf n yinig, n tedrimt neɣ imukan.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Izmer ad ilhu usexdem n tkebbanit n uḥewwes i yezgan tettheggi-d inigen am win tebɣiḍ.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Tikebbaniyin n usneɣmes zgant skiddibent ɣef yiswi n waya, imi qqaren-d d akken yella-d i wakken ad "qeḍeεen tudert tabaḍnit".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Di tilawt, ingalen n temnaḍin ur sεin ara akk asemdu ɣef tenɣelt taruzrift; tanɣelt n telɣut-s-telɣut n uḍebsi ad telḥu akken iwata deg yal tamacint anda ad ilḥu uẓaṛan.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Imi leḥḥun isawalen deg Internet, ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara ad tesxedmeḍ takebbanit n tiliɣṛi i d-yezgan anda tzedɣeḍ neɣ sani tettinigeḍ.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Ur d-ssuturen ara daɣen ad tesεuḍ uṭṭun adigan seg tmazdayt anda tzedɣeḍ; tzemreḍ ad tesεuḍ tuqqna Internet n ugensa deg tẓegwa n Uyaẓiḍ, Alaska yerna ad tferneḍ uṭṭun i d-yesbanayen d akken telliḍ ddaw n yiṭij n Arizuna.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Tikkwal, ilaq ad taɣeḍ uṭṭun agraɣlan weḥdes yettaǧǧan tiliɣṛa Lweqt Ilaw n Ubrutukul Uɛassi i wakken ad ak-d-ssiwlen. Tella-d tmeẓla seg ansi yella wuṭṭun i yimdanen i ak-d-yessawalen.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Isnasen n umsuɣel anbabbar n uḍris - isnasen izemren ad ssuɣlen s wudem awurman iḥricen ummiden n uḍris seg tutlayt ɣer tayeḍ.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Kra seg yesnasen deg taggayt-agi zemren ad ssuɣlen ula d iḍrisen deg tutlayin tibeṛṛaniyin ɣef yesɣilen neɣ tiɣawsiwin niḍen deg tilawt mi ara d-yessewεed usemras tiliɣṛi ɣer tɣawsiwin-nni.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Iseɣzanen n usuɣel selhan nezzeh, yerna tura ttaken-d tikkwal tisuɣilin iṣeḥḥan akka ciṭ (drus mliḥ usexleḍ ur nettwafham), maca ilaq leḥder, imi mazal-iten zemren ad tt-rwin akk.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Yiwen seg yesnasen ixataren akk deg taggayt-agi d Asuɣel Gugle, yettaǧǧan asuɣel beṛṛa n tuqqna seld assider n usefku n tutlayt i k-yehwan.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Asexdem n yesnasen n ussilel GBS deg ufafus-ik amegzu d tamamekt isehlen akk d tin iwulmen akk i ussilel mi ra tiliḍ beṛṛa n tmurt-ik n tlalit.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Yezmer ad yejmeε idrimen s tiɣin n tkarḍiwin timaynutin i GBS, neɣ tamacint timanit GBS neɣ lekra n yiwen seg tkebbanit n lekra n tkeryas.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ma yella ur tesεiḍ ara tuqqna n yisefka i tiluɣṛi-inek, neɣ mi ur tzemmreḍ ara ad teṭṭfeḍ, aselḥu-nsen yezmer ad yesεu tilas neɣ ur yettili ara.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Yal taḥanut n usellek teččur d tifelwiyin yessewhamen n tkarḍiwin n tiliɣṛi yettwaxellaṣen uqbel i tzemreḍ ad tesxedmeḍ si tiliɣṛi azayez neɣ tiliɣri umṛis.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Imi tuget n tkarḍin lhant i usiwel anda id ak-yehwa, kra muzzgen deg tikci n yifmiḍiyen imeεnen n ussiwel i yigrawen usdiden n tmura.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Anekcum ɣer yimeẓla-agi yezga yella seg uṭṭun n tiliɣṛi war idrimen uɣur tzemreḍ ad tessiwleḍ seg tuget n tiliɣṛa mebla axelleṣ.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ilugan yeεnan aṣewwer umṛis εnan ula asurret n ufidyu, ahat ugar n waya.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Ma yella yettugdel ad teṭṭfeḍ tawlaft n tɣawsa, ihi ur k-ilaq ara ula d axemmem ɣef usurret n ufidyu fell-as.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Ma yella tessxedmeḍ adrun, selken mliḥ di tazwara d acu i tzemreḍ ad tessurteḍ akked wacu n ttesriḥat neɣ turagin n tmerna i d-ssutren.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Affug n udrun zdat n unafag neɣ nnig n lɣaci d tikti n diri s wudem qrib amezgi, ɣas akken ur yelli d aruzrif deg tmurt-ik.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Ass am ass-a inig deg igenni drus maḍi ad yettwaḥeṛ srid si tkebbanit n isufag mebla ma yella-d unadi d userwes di tazwara n sswami.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Tikkwal yiwen n wafug yezmer ad yesεu sswami yemgaraden mliḥ ɣer waṭas n yismal yerna ilaq ad txellseḍ aserwes igemmaḍen n unadi akked uwali deg yismal web n tkebbanit n isufag s timmad-is send aḥeṛṛi.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Γas akken ur tetteḥwiǧiḍ ara afiza i uḥewwes wezzilen ɣer kra n tmura d amerray neɣ i uxeddim, ma yella truḥeḍ d anelmad agraɣlan ad ak-d-ssutren s umata akud n yiɣimi ɣezzifen ɣef ma yella truḥeḍ d amerray kan umṛis.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: S umata, iɣimi deg tmurt tabeṛṛanit i tallit n wakud ɣezzifen yessuter ad tawiḍ afiza uqbel.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ifizaten n yinelmaden tikalayin-nsent n usuter d ujerred mgaradent s wudem amatu ɣef tid n yifisaten n umarray umṛis neɣ n uxeddim.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Deg tuget n tmura, ad teḥwiǧeḍ tabṛat n ucekker seg tsudut anda tebɣiḍ ad tlemdeḍ, akked daɣen ttbut n yedrimen i wakken ad trefdeḍ iman-ik meqqar aseggas amenzu n ulmad-ik.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Wali akked tsudut, akked ugezdu n yinig ɣef tmurt anda tebɣiḍ ad tlemdeḍ i ugar n yissallen.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Siwa ma telliḍ d adiblumaṭ, iqeddcen akkin i yilel ilaq-ak ad tesserseḍ acḥal n yidrimen i tettaɣeḍ deg tmurt anda i tzedɣeḍ.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Taẓeṭṭaṭ n yedrimen i tettaɣeḍ tebna s umgarad deg tmura yemgaraden, yerna ifmiḍiyen d wazalen n tẓeṭṭaṭ d anḍiyen mliḥ si tmurt ɣer tayeḍ.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Di kra n tmura tifidiraliyin, am Yiwunak Yedduklen d Kanada, taẓeṭṭaṭ n yidrimen i tettaɣeḍ tettili-d ɣer uswir afidirali d uswir adigan di sin, ihi ifmiḍen d wazalen d anḍiyen si tama ɣer tayeḍ.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Γas akken asefqed n yinig yezga iɣab neɣ yettili-d kan d lwajeb mi ad tawḍeḍ ɣer tmurt-ik, yezmer ad yili usefqed n tdawna d asawen.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tḥeq d akken teẓriḍ acu tzemreḍ d wacu ur tezmireḍ ara ad tawiḍ yerna mel-d kullec deg tilisa tuzrifin.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Tamamekt isehlen akk i wakken ad tebduḍ deg leqdic n tira n yinig d asemsed n twezza-ik deg usmel web n tira n yinig ibedden.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Seld mi ara tissineḍ ad tsegmeḍ asebter yerna ad tjerdeḍ ɣef usmel, imir sakkin, tzemreḍ ad tesnulfuḍ asmel-ik web i yiman-ik.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Tiwizi deg yinig d tamamekt igerrzen i wakken ad teǧǧeḍ amgired maca ur d-yelli ɣef tikci kan.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Tudert d tiwizi deg tmurt tabeṛṛanit d tamamekt igerrzen i wakken ad tissineḍ adles yemgaraden, ad temlileḍ imdanen imaynuten, ad tlemdeḍ kra ɣef yiman-ik, ad tkesbeḍ tamuɣli niḍen yerna ad trebḥeḍ ula d tiwezza timaynutin.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Tezmer ad tili daɣen d tamamekt yelhan i wakken ad tjemεeḍ ugar n yidrimen i wakken ad teqqimeḍ akud ɣezzifen anda tufiḍ imi aṭas n leqdicat n yiwaziwen ttaken taxxamt d wučči yerna kra ttxelliṣen ciṭ.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Ifikingen llan ttaṭṭafen iberdan n ussilel Irussiyen i wakken ad awḍen ɣer Yilel Aberkan akked Yilel Akasbyan. Mazal zemren yemdanen ad awin iḥricen n yiberdan-agi. Walit acu n ttesriḥat imeẓliyen i tzemrem ad tiḥwiǧem, iweεren i wakken ahat ad ten-id-awiḍ.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Ma yella tesεiḍ akud n yinig n tmerna, wali ssuma tummidt ɣer Tefṛiqt dɣa serwes-itt akked ssuma n yinig ɣer yakk amaḍal.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Tanḍiyin n Tefranṣiṣt ttmeslayen di Beljik d Swis mgaradent ciṭ si Tefranṣiṣt ttmeslayen di Franṣa, ɣas akken ttemcabint deqs-nsent i wakken ad ttwafhament.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Ladɣa, anagraw n wuṭṭunen deg Beljik d Swiss yettmeslayen Tafranṣiṣt yesεa ciṭ n tulmisin yemgaraden si Tefranṣiṣt ttmeslayen di Franṣa, yerna asenṭeq n kra n wawalen yemgarad cwiṭ.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Maca, akk Ibeljiken d Iswissiyen yettmeslayen Tafranṣiṣt lemden Tafranṣiṣt tamagnut deg uɣerbaz, ihi ad izmiren ad k-fehmen ɣas akken tesxedmeḍ anagraw n wuṭṭunen Afranṣiṣ amagnu.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Deg waṭas n tamiwin n umaḍal, asewεed d asekni n tdukkli, anamek-is "azul".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Maca, di Malaysya, deg tamiwin n tmurt di Malaysya, anamek-is "iya-d ɣer da", yettemcabi ɣer uskin iwehhan ɣer tfekka, asekni issexdamen di kra n tmura Tutrimin, yerna yettusexdem kan i yiswi-nni.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
